# https://educademy.github.io
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>EduCademy | Decode Your Dreams - IT Training in Pune</title>
<meta name="description" content="EduCademy offers practical IT training in Software Testing (Manual & Automation), Data Analyst and Data Science in Pune.">
<style>
  :root {
    --navy-900: #050d1f;
    --navy-800: #0a1730;
    --navy-700: #0f2244;
    --navy-600: #16305c;
    --blue-400: #7ab8ea;
    --blue-300: #a6d2f5;
    --blue-500: #4a9ad8;
    --text: #e6eefa;
    --muted: #9fb3cf;
    --card: #0d1d3a;
    --border: rgba(122, 184, 234, 0.18);
    --radius: 14px;
  }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
  body {
    font-family: "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--navy-900) 0%, var(--navy-800) 100%);
    color: var(--text);
    line-height: 1.6;
  }
  a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
  img { max-width: 100%; display: block; }
  .container { width: min(1140px, 92%); margin: 0 auto; }
  section { padding: 80px 0; }
  .section-title { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 48px; }
  .section-title h2 { font-size: clamp(1.7rem, 3vw, 2.4rem); margin-bottom: 10px; }
  .section-title p { color: var(--muted); max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; }
  .eyebrow {
    display: inline-block; font-size: 0.8rem; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--blue-400); margin-bottom: 10px;
  }
  .btn {
    display: inline-block; padding: 13px 26px; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 600;
    transition: transform .2s, box-shadow .2s, background .2s; cursor: pointer; border: none; font-size: 1rem;
  }
  .btn-primary {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--blue-400), var(--blue-500)); color: var(--navy-900);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(74, 154, 216, 0.35);
  }
  .btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(74, 154, 216, 0.45); }
  .btn-outline { border: 1.5px solid var(--blue-400); color: var(--blue-300); background: transparent; }
  .btn-outline:hover { background: rgba(122, 184, 234, 0.1); }

  /* Header */
  header {
    position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 100;
    background: rgba(5, 13, 31, 0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 72px; }
  .brand img { height: 52px; width: 52px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 10px; }
  .brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.25rem; }
  .brand span { color: var(--blue-300); }
  nav ul { display: flex; gap: 28px; list-style: none; }
  nav ul a { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.95rem; transition: color .2s; }
  nav ul a:hover { color: var(--blue-300); }
  .menu-toggle { display: none; background: none; border: none; color: var(--text); font-size: 1.6rem; cursor: pointer; }

  /* Hero */
  .hero { padding: 80px 0 90px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
  .hero::before {
    content: ""; position: absolute; width: 600px; height: 600px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(74, 154, 216, 0.25), transparent 70%);
    top: -200px; right: -150px; pointer-events: none;
  }
  .hero-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 0.9fr; gap: 56px; align-items: center; position: relative; }
  .hero h1 { font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 4.5vw, 3.4rem); line-height: 1.15; margin-bottom: 18px; }
  .hero h1 em { font-style: normal; color: var(--blue-400); }
  .hero p.lead { color: var(--muted); font-size: 1.1rem; margin-bottom: 28px; max-width: 540px; }
  .hero-ctas { display: flex; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .hero-badges { display: flex; gap: 22px; margin-top: 34px; flex-wrap: wrap; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.9rem; }
  .hero-badges div::before { content: "✓ "; color: var(--blue-400); font-weight: 700; }

  .form-card {
    background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 20px; padding: 36px;
    box-shadow: 0 30px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
  }
  .form-card h3 { font-size: 1.4rem; margin-bottom: 6px; }
  .form-card > p { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.95rem; margin-bottom: 22px; }
  .field { margin-bottom: 14px; }
  .field label { display: block; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 6px; }
  .field input, .field select {
    width: 100%; padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: var(--navy-800); color: var(--text); font-size: 0.97rem; outline: none;
  }
  .field input:focus, .field select:focus { border-color: var(--blue-400); }
  .form-card .btn { width: 100%; margin-top: 6px; }
  .form-success { display: none; margin-top: 14px; color: var(--blue-300); font-size: 0.95rem; text-align: center; }

  /* Course strip */
  .strip { background: var(--navy-700); padding: 22px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
  .strip-inner { display: flex; justify-content: space-around; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 20px; text-align: center; }
  .strip-inner strong { display: block; font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--blue-300); }
  .strip-inner span { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.9rem; }

  /* Courses */
  .courses-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr)); gap: 26px; }
  .course-card {
    background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius);
    padding: 32px 28px; transition: transform .25s, border-color .25s; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  }
  .course-card:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); border-color: var(--blue-400); }
  .course-icon {
    width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 14px; display: grid; place-items: center;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy-600), var(--navy-700)); color: var(--blue-300);
    font-size: 1.6rem; margin-bottom: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .course-card h3 { font-size: 1.3rem; margin-bottom: 10px; }
  .course-card > p { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.95rem; margin-bottom: 18px; }
  .course-card ul { list-style: none; margin-bottom: 24px; flex: 1; }
  .course-card li { color: var(--text); font-size: 0.92rem; padding: 6px 0; padding-left: 22px; position: relative; }
  .course-card li::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 14px; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--blue-400); }
  .course-meta { display: flex; gap: 14px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.85rem; margin-bottom: 18px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .course-card .btn { text-align: center; }

  /* Why */
  .why { background: var(--navy-900); }
  .why-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr)); gap: 22px; }
  .why-item { padding: 28px; border-radius: var(--radius); border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--navy-800); }
  .why-item .ico { font-size: 1.8rem; margin-bottom: 14px; }
  .why-item h4 { font-size: 1.1rem; margin-bottom: 8px; }
  .why-item p { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.93rem; }

  /* Process */
  .steps { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 24px; counter-reset: step; }
  .step { position: relative; padding: 28px 24px; background: var(--card); border-radius: var(--radius); border: 1px solid var(--border); }
  .step-num {
    width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; font-weight: 700;
    background: var(--blue-400); color: var(--navy-900); margin-bottom: 16px;
  }
  .step h4 { margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 1.05rem; }
  .step p { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.92rem; }

  /* FAQ */
  .faq { max-width: 820px; margin: 0 auto; }
  details {
    background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 18px 22px; margin-bottom: 14px;
  }
  summary { cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; list-style: none; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; }
  summary::after { content: "+"; color: var(--blue-400); font-size: 1.4rem; margin-left: 12px; }
  details[open] summary::after { content: "−"; }
  details p { color: var(--muted); margin-top: 12px; font-size: 0.95rem; }

  /* Contact */
  .contact { background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--navy-800), var(--navy-900)); }
  .contact-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 40px; align-items: start; }
  .contact-info { display: grid; gap: 22px; }
  .contact-item { display: flex; gap: 16px; align-items: flex-start; }
  .contact-item .ico {
    width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 12px; display: grid; place-items: center; flex-shrink: 0;
    background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border); font-size: 1.2rem;
  }
  .contact-item h4 { font-size: 1rem; margin-bottom: 2px; }
  .contact-item p, .contact-item a { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.97rem; }
  .contact-item a:hover { color: var(--blue-300); }

  /* Footer */
  footer { background: var(--navy-900); border-top: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 52px 0 26px; }
  .footer-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 40px; margin-bottom: 36px; }
  .footer-grid h5 { font-size: 0.95rem; margin-bottom: 14px; color: var(--blue-300); }
  .footer-grid ul { list-style: none; }
  .footer-grid li { margin-bottom: 8px; }
  .footer-grid a, .footer-grid p { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.92rem; }
  .footer-grid a:hover { color: var(--blue-300); }
  .footer-bottom { border-top: 1px solid var(--border); padding-top: 22px; text-align: center; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.85rem; }

  /* Mobile */
  @media (max-width: 900px) {
    .hero-grid, .contact-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  }
  @media (max-width: 720px) {
    section { padding: 60px 0; }
    nav ul {
      display: none; position: absolute; top: 72px; left: 0; right: 0; flex-direction: column; gap: 0;
      background: var(--navy-900); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 10px 0;
    }
    nav ul.open { display: flex; }
    nav ul li a { display: block; padding: 12px 6%; }
    .menu-toggle { display: block; }
    .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .form-card { padding: 26px; }
  }
</style>
</head>

<script>
  const toggle = document.getElementById('toggle');
  const menu = document.getElementById('menu');
  toggle.addEventListener('click', () => menu.classList.toggle('open'));
  menu.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(a => a.addEventListener('click', () => menu.classList.remove('open')));

  function handleForm(formId, okId) {
    const form = document.getElementById(formId);
    form.addEventListener('submit', e => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const inputs = form.querySelectorAll('input[required]');
      let valid = true;
      inputs.forEach(i => {
        if (!i.value.trim()) valid = false;
      });
      if (!valid) return;
      document.getElementById(okId).style.display = 'block';
      form.reset();
    });
  }
  handleForm('leadForm', 'ok');
  handleForm('contactForm', 'ok2');

  document.getElementById('yr').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();
</script>
</body>
</html>
